You see Viola.
  • Greetings, adventurer!
  • How may I help you today?

Location

Newhaven Magic Shop

Notes

In the past, Viola taught magic to the adventurers who explored the island. Now, she is retired and devotes her time to reading and the study of magic.

History

Since update 15.22.c93366, she no longer teaches spells.

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Viola.

Player: hi
Viola: Welcome Player! Are you here for new wisdom or do you have time for a mission?
Player: bye
Viola: Goodbye and take care.
Player: name
Viola: My name is Viola. How can I help you?
Player: wisdom
Viola: I was fortunate enough to receive a good education, I especially enjoy reading books about restoration, illusion and alteration.
Player: job
Viola: I used to teach new spells to young adventurers like you, Player. My knowledge in several different fields made it possible for me to teach spells to every vocation. But these days I'm focusing more on reading, on that note...
Viola: One of my favorite books has gone missing.
Player: mission / books
Viola: Thank you for finding my book, now I can finally get back to reading more about magic.
Player: sell
Viola: I'm sorry to disappoint you, only Avriel is buying goods from your adventures.
Player: boat
Viola: The only boat that connects us to the island Targuna is owned by Anna. Her house is east of mine and has a super fancy door, I'm sure that you can't unsee it.
Player: time
Viola: It's exactly <time>.
Player: Newhaven / island
Viola: Our little island once had a strong economy based on the mines. Lots of workers came from overseas to work here. I still remember that beautiful harbour we had here, good old times.
Player: mainland
Viola: The mainland with its capital Thais
Player: Thais
Viola: A good friend of mine used to live there, such a beautiful city. I always enjoyed my stay at Kingsday tho', can't recommend it enough.
Player: king
Viola: The king's castle is in Thais, make sure to visit it someday.
Player: shop
Viola: You can find the shop just east of here. Avriel will get you going with everything you need.
Player: bank
Viola: The bank can be found just north of us. Flavius will take care of all your financial needs.
Player: guard
Viola: Gustavo serves as our guard, keeping us safe from the northern part of the island. It can get pretty dangerous there, take care if you ever find yourself there.
Player: danger
Viola: Those muglex have been terrorising our little village for a while now, maybe you could talk to Gustavo. I bet he knows more about them.
Player: muglex
Viola: These little green goblins once arrived with ships, ever since our village has been under constant attack. Fortunately the wooden walls and Gustavo are keeping the danger out.
Player: learn / teach
Viola: Unfortunately here's nothing left to learn here. I gave up teaching spells some time ago. You will be fine, I'm sure!
Viola: I could use some assistens with another matter, if you're interested. One of my favorite books has gone missing.
Player: knowledge
Viola: My mother always told me, knowledge is power. I guess that's why it became such an important part of my life.
Player: mines
Viola: These mines were once a thriving force for workers and investors alike, ever since the last ores have been mined, these trenches have been abandoned for good.
Viola: I'm sure you have already been told about the news.
Player: news
Viola: Haven't you heard about the rockslide?!
Viola: Just a few days ago we heard a loud noise from the mines
Viola: Supposedly another area has been revealed above the main mine itself.
Viola: Someone should check that out soon ...
Player: helmet
Viola: Oh wow, you found what?!
Viola: That sounds scary, I don't want to experience that at all!
Viola: I remember talking to some women in Thais about something similar, but what was her name again - Anna? Henna? Janna?
Viola: I'm sorry, but I don't remember it exactly
Player: hints
Viola: Always eat as much food as possible. This way, you'll regenerate health points for a longer period of time.
Player: Tibianus
Viola: He's been ruling over Tibia for quite some time now, may he take good care of us for years to come!
Player: Anna
Viola: Anna always enjoyed the thrill of the open sea. She often supplies Avriels shop with goods for all of us. Then you're ready to leave I suggest talking to her.
Player: Avriel
Viola: Avriel takes care of our little shop just west from my house. When you're looking for supplies or want to sell stuff, you should talk to him.
Player: Flavius
Viola: Flavius is the banker on our island. When you need any financial advice, you will find him just north of my house.
Player: Gustavo
Viola: Ahh, yes my dearest Gustavo. He's the guard of our little village protecting us from the muglex. If you're interested in helping, you should talk to him.
Player: Rosina
Viola: Rosina is well known for her positive attitude and even more for her great guesthouse on a small island west of Newhaven.
Player: Viola
Viola: Yes?
Player: Tim
Viola: He once visited over from Thais, I heard Gustavo and him are good friends.

Viola
